احترفن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَرَفْنَ (iḥtarafna) /iħ.ta.raf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# اُحْتُرِفْنَ (uḥturifna) /uħ.tu.rif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# اِحْتَرِفْنَ (iḥtarifna) /iħ.ta.rif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
